rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: For the 118th (special) session convened on 2.2.27 (27 February 1990), the House of Councillors' table records in its 参議院の指名 column the House's designation of 海部俊樹 on 2.2.27: first ballot 246 votes (majority 124), 海部俊樹 110; runoff 246 votes, 海部俊樹 111, 土井たか子 91, 44 blank.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In its 衆議院の指名 column the same row records the House of Representatives' designation of 海部俊樹 on 2.2.27: 508 votes (majority 255), 海部俊樹 286; the days-to-designation column gives the day of convocation, which the table also gives as the day of the Cabinet's resignation decision.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The remarks column for the 118th session lists 2.1.24 dissolution of the House of Representatives, 2.2.18 general election and 2.2.27 海部内閣総辞職決定 (the Kaifu cabinet's decision to resign en masse).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same remarks column lists 2.2.28 第二次海部内閣成立 (formation of the second Kaifu cabinet).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: For the 122nd (extraordinary) session convened on 3.11.5 (5 November 1991), the table records in its 参議院の指名 column the House's designation of 宮澤喜一 on 3.11.5: first ballot 245 votes (majority 123), 宮澤喜一 115; runoff 244 votes, 宮澤喜一 115, 田邊誠 85, 44 blank.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In its 衆議院の指名 column the same row records the House of Representatives' designation of 宮澤喜一 on 3.11.5: 492 votes (majority 247), 宮澤喜一 276, with one blank and one ballot giving only a surname that two members share; the days-to-designation column reads 召集日（内閣総辞職決定日）.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The remarks column for the 122nd session lists 3.11.5 海部内閣総辞職決定.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same remarks column lists 3.11.5 宮澤内閣成立.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: For the 127th (special) session convened on 5.8.5 (5 August 1993), the table records in its 参議院の指名 column the House's designation of 細川護熙 (printed with 熙) on 5.8.6: 240 votes (majority 121), 細川護熙 132, 河野洋平 93, 不破哲三 11, 4 blank.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In its 衆議院の指名 column the same row records the House of Representatives' designation of 細川護熙 on 5.8.6: 503 votes (majority 252), 細川護熙 262, 河野洋平 224, 不破哲三 15, 山花貞夫 2; the days-to-designation column reads 召集日から二日.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The remarks column for the 127th session lists 5.6.18 dissolution of the House of Representatives, 5.7.18 general election and 5.8.5 宮澤内閣総辞職決定.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same remarks column lists 5.8.9 細川内閣成立.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-12 only. Each House's designation vote, any joint committee and the House of Representatives' prevailing resolution, the Imperial appointment ceremony, Kantei statements and accounts, a cabinet's formation, its resignation en masse, any continued performance of duties and acting service stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this role in this packet: an unnamed statement, agenda or ceremony record, an acting prime minister, the House of Councillors' 1998 designee or the successor at the closing boundary. Ministers, deputy prime ministers and party offices are excluded.
